name: Yudiz Solutions Ltd.
summary: Yudiz Solutions Ltd. is an India-based information technology company specializing in digital transformation and IT consulting services for clients both domestically and internationally. The company focuses on providing scalable and secure solutions across various emerging technologies. Its primary services include mobile app development, website development, and UI/UX design. Yudiz Solutions also offers specialized development in areas such as Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, blockchain technology, and Augmented Reality/Virtual Reality. A significant portion of their business involves game development, encompassing various casual and strategy games, as well as platform development for metaverse, e-commerce, on-demand, and OTT applications. The company serves a diverse range of industries including healthcare, human resources, social media, food delivery, fintech, gaming, education, and supply chain.
